chunks: Those who relate traditions are of four categories, no more.
ai.seo_question: What are the four categories of hadith narrators according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This narration from Nahj al-Balagha categorizes the narrators of hadith into four distinct groups, implying that the transmission of religious knowledge is limited to these specific types of individuals. It serves as a foundational statement for understanding the reliability and classification of Islamic traditions. In Shia scholarship, this classification is often interpreted to highlight the importance of verifying the chain of transmission (isnad) and the moral integrity of narrators, ensuring the authenticity of the Prophet's teachings.
